segments.text: Look at these photos of famous scientists.
Oh, this is Tu Youyou, a Nobel Prize winner.
Yes. What do you know about her?
She discovered qinghaosu and has saved many lives.
Do you know the story of “Newton’s apple”?

Yes, I do. The story is like this. Young Newton was thinking about the universe under an apple tree. Suddenly an apple fell on his head. He thought hard about the reasons for the fall of apples. And later he discovered the Law of Gravity.
Look, Qian Xuesen, a rocket scientist. I’m a big fan of him.
I’m also interested in outer space. I want to be a scientist like him in the future.

Yuan Longping was born in Beijing in 1930. In the 1960s, as the nation was short of food, Mr Yuan began to do research on hybrid rice. He was creative and hard-working. His hybrid rice has fed many people.
Mr Yuan is known as the “Father of Hybrid Rice”.
Alexander Graham Bell was born in Scotland in 1847. He was always curious about new things. He and his assistant Thomas Watson invented the world’s first practical telephone.
Bell was interested in many research areas. He invented a lot of techniques to help the deaf.
